title: Platform Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Choosing a Robot Arm
description: Set a weight for each of five criteria and watch the weighted totals of three robot arms reorder. Then recommend the SO-ARM101, the reBot B601-DM or the reBot B601-RS for six project situations, applying each requirement as a filter before weighing the rest. Used in Chapter 9.

educational.topic: Platform selection criteria: cost, payload, learning curve, software and power
learningObjectives: Recommend one of three robot arms (the SO-ARM101, the reBot B601-DM or the reBot B601-RS) for each of six project situations by applying the platform selection criteria, with at least 5 of 6 recommendations correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Separate requirements from preferences: filter the arms by the requirements in a situation, then judge what remains against the criteria
keyQuestions: Which facts in the situation are requirements, and which are preferences?
Can a high weighted total rescue an arm that fails a requirement?
commonMisconceptions: The most capable arm is always the best choice
A weighted score decides a hard requirement
The cheapest arm can do any job
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed recommendations, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Weight of each of five criteria
